title: 13F institutional ownership (data/inst_ownership/{quarter}/latest.parquet, per-row record)
description: Producer: data/derived/inst_ownership.py::write_inst_ownership_parquet (InstOwnershipRow). One row per (ticker, quarter). Consumer: crucible v2's point-in-time institutional-ownership source (crucible/data/point_in_time.py::SnapshotPointInTimeSource._load_institutional), which reads `{prefix}/{quarter}/latest.parquet` via `crucible.keys.inst_ownership_key(year, quarter)` and hard-requires `ticker`, `n_funds_increasing`, `n_funds_decreasing` (`INSTITUTIONAL_COLUMNS`) — a missing column raises `MissingSourceError`, never a zero-fill. Data-collector plan P-07 (alpha-engine-config-I10870, D39). This schema validates ONE ROW after `rows_to_dataframe(rows).to_dict('records')` — the persisted artifact is the parquet, not a JSON document; the row shape is the contract.
